svg.title: 2012 Algiers–Orleans settlement: public debt, not an heir's payment
svg.desc: An original Final Vestige Studios document-based accounting diagram: 7.62 percent allocated debt share totaled 6,215,840 dollars; 2,210,075 dollars already held in escrow for Algiers was deducted; resulting 4,005,765 dollars was reported as paid by Algiers to settle its debt-share obligations. The agreement also relinquished Algiers's interest in Orleans non-flood assets and Bohemia Properties, but does not document any payment to an individual Bohemia heir.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios; created: 2026-11-17; copyright: © 2026 Final Vestige Studios, original vector figure. Documentary basis: Southeast Louisiana Flood Protection Authority–West, Annual Financial Report for year ended June 30, 2012, Note H printed pages 61–62, released October 17, 2012, https://app.lla.state.la.us/PublicReports.nsf/B0875E563481701486257A99006FB923/$FILE/0002D142.pdf . No third-party graphics, historical photograph, or AI reconstruction. Suggested alt: In 2012, Algiers's 7.62% share of selected Orleans district debt was $6,215,840; minus $2,210,075 held in escrow, leaving $4,005,765 paid. A separate clause renounced Algiers's interest in Bohemia Properties, not private claimants' rights.
svg.text: February 13, 2012 · Algiers and Orleans levee districts
Algiers's 7.62% share of identified district debt
Less funds already held in escrow for Algiers
Payment reported in the audited financial statements
Algiers relinquished claims to Orleans non-flood
Not a claimant restitution receipt or Bohemia royalty ledger.
Source: LLA / FPA–West FY2012 audit, Note H, pp. 61–62 · © FV Studios 2026
